obituaries.full_text:
MILLSBORO: Nov. 19 - (Special)- Mrs. Matilda J. Harmon, 86, widow of Thomas Harmon of Millsboro, died at her home yesterday. She had been in failing health for several months.

Theodore Harmon  
July 30, 
1965
